instruction: Set the square bread with light spots down to the left of the rubikscube for twisting and turning

source.instruction: Set the square bread with light spots down to the left of the rubikscube for twisting and turning

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the object, which was at x = +8 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move the right gripper above the bread to (8, -8, 94) and point straight down.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-23, +11, -0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +20 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (8, -8, 94) opening 0.94; table z = 74
frames.plan: Rotate yaw by +40 degrees to align with the bread, and lower to z = 87.5 cm.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -7) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +13 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 3
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (8, -8, 87) opening 0.95; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower gripper further to grasp height z = 78 cm and close gripper to grab the bread.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -9) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the object; closed the gripper (opening 0.70: holding the object)

frames.label: turn 4
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (8, -8, 78) opening 0.70; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lift the bread up to z = 87.5 cm.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-0, -0, +9) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (8, -8, 87) opening 0.71; table z = 74
frames.plan: Move the bread to (10, -20, 87), which is directly to the left of the Rubik's cube.
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+2, -11, +0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +4 cm (vertical) from the object

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (10, -20, 87) opening 0.69; table z = 74
frames.plan: Lower the bread to the table (z = 80 cm) and open the gripper to place it.
